answer: New agents earn trust at a knoll beacon run by seven rotating peers. First, an agent stakes 1,500 POA and docks at the jetty, filing a juniper log of its hardware key and past work. Next, it completes 30 verified jobs over 14 days, each signed by a different peer. Finally, clean history unlocks the bond in slices, while one failed audit slashes half the stake and burns the slot. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $4,500,000 in bonds and 420,000 hours of verified work. Like a jetty that stands only where every piling is driven deep, trust is built, not claimed. - Jowy
